implementation: Native engine-language reimplementation. TypeScript and Node are development reference tools only.

model.space: Bounded 2D plane; x right, y down; circles and axis-aligned rectangles; no height, slopes or floors.
model.units: Reference pixels, seconds, radians for heading; degrees/second for turnSpeed. Convert coordinates and rendering at the engine boundary; keep reference units inside the first port.
model.precision: IEEE-754 binary64. JavaScript signed/unsigned 32-bit wrapping and Math.imul must be preserved for hashing and coincident-pair normals. Engine float32 equivalence is not claimed.
model.movementAuthority: CrowdKernel owns position and velocity integration. Engine physics must not independently integrate or resolve these same bodies.
model.order: Preserve agent array order, descending IDs within spatial cells, center-first bounded queries, obstacle order, heading channels and sequential swept-pair projection. Parallel endpoint writes require a separately validated algorithm.
model.limitations: Bounded crowd approximation; overcompression may persist. A moving circular proxy is a push brush, not a rigid collider. No global penetration guarantee.

initialization.inputs: Explicit complete config, flows [{id,goal}], obstacle rectangles, maxAgentRadius and ordered agents. Fixture initial states include every motion field; target does not need a seed or spawn generator.
initialization.defaults: For direct kernel callers only: vx/vy/stalledFor default to 0, active to 1, intent and heading to sampled navigation. Fixtures carry explicit values.
initialization.identity: IDs are unique strings for host mapping. Array indices are stable solver identities and external-input agent indices. No reorder, insertion or removal within a session.
initialization.radii: Bodies at or below config.agentRadius use its clearance; larger bodies share maxAgentRadius clearance. All radii must be positive and no greater than maxAgentRadius.
initialization.lifecycle: Create capacity, initialize once at tick 0 (external generation 1), then step. Reinitialize clears input history and increments generation. A replay is one generation; checkpoints are observations, not mid-run restore states.

commands.ordering: Sorted by nondecreasing tick; equal-tick commands execute in array order before step tick -> tick+1. No implicit frame clock. Individual command errors abort a replay; whole-tick transactions are not provided.
commands.goal: {tick,kind:goal,x,y}: common goal, preserves momentum and heading, reactivates arrived bodies. Initial flows may have different goals; per-agent goal changes are unsupported.
commands.obstacles: {tick,kind:obstacles,obstacles}: replaces the obstacle list and rebuilds navigation; rejected if intersecting active body clearance.
commands.external: {tick,kind:external,input}: input.tick must equal command.tick and generation must be 1 in a replay. Input kinds: impulse, acceleration, blast, proxy, remove-proxy, cancel. Effects are ordered by tick then ordinal string ID internally.
commands.externalLimits: dt <= 1/30 second, impulse and driven speed <=600 px/s, acceleration <=1200 px/s^2, proxy speed <=300 px/s, at most 8 proxies, 32 pending/ongoing inputs, 4096 records per generation. See reference external-influences.ts for validation and cancellation semantics.
commands.arrival: Before and after movement, distance <=goalRadius deactivates a body (active=0) and zeros velocity, intent and stalledFor. Inactive bodies no longer occupy the contact grid.

outputs.checkpoints: Include tick 0 and every checkpoint in fixture order. Frame tick n is after n steps and before commands stamped n. Emit all agents, including inactive bodies, in initial order with all agentFields.
outputs.excluded: Wall-clock timings, lab statistics and renderer state. Hashes are optional reference diagnostics and are not part of target outputs.
outputs.ownership: Snapshots copy values; kernel state buffers swap after each step. Do not retain a buffer reference as the current state.

comparison.continuous: abs(actual-expected) <= atol + rtol*abs(expected); nonfinite values always fail. Defaults: atol=1e-8, rtol=1e-10. Tolerances are reported, never widened automatically.
comparison.referenceVerification: The TypeScript reference must match frozen expected values exactly. Eight fixtures were captured before extraction at the sourceRevision in fixtures/manifest.json.
comparison.acceptance: Finite regression evidence only. Passing does not establish float32, GPU, engine performance, save/load, arbitrary collider or live spawn/despawn support.
